name: Rotational SliceGPT INT4 Compressor — Production-Hardened.
description: Rotational SliceGPT INT4 Compressor — Production-Hardened.  Combines orthogonal rotation, variance-based subspace slicing, and second-order INT4 non-uniform quantization.  Mathematical formulation:   1. Rotation:       W̃ = W Q,   X̃ = Qᵀ X,   Qᵀ Q = I   2. Slicing:        P_r = [e_i] for top-r var(X̃) channels                      W_sliced = W̃ P_r,   X_sliced = P_rᵀ X̃   3. Hessian INT4:   H = 2
math_latex: \\widetilde{W} = W Q, \\quad \\widetilde{X} = Q^\\top X, \\quad Q^\\top Q = I

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
